title: Stripe Billing Invoice Invoice Total Leaderboard
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stripe:invoice invoice_total_usd=*
| stats sum(invoice_total_usd) as total_value, avg(invoice_total_usd) as avg_value by vendor_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks vendor name values by total and average invoice total across Stripe Billing invoice events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `invoice_total_usd` values for each Stripe Billing invoice event and review total and average invoice total by vendor name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total invoice total.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which vendor name shows the biggest invoice total numbers in your Stripe Billing invoice data.
